svg.text: N64xCart Dumper VERSION 1.1 — Cartridge Slot Connector (TOP-DOWN VIEW)
You are looking straight DOWN onto the connector from directly above — the device lying flat, slot opening facing up toward you.
Pin 1 = bottom row, far left. Pin 26 = top row, far left. Column N: bottom pin = N, top pin = N+25.
N64xCart Dumper VERSION 1.1 — Cartridge Slot Connector (BOTTOM VIEW)
Board flipped LEFT ⟷ RIGHT from the view above (like turning a page) to look at the solder side from below.
Pin 1 = bottom row, far RIGHT now. Pin 26 = top row, far RIGHT now. Row positions (top/bottom) are unchanged.
